Selected project / 09

Canadian Real-Estate Data

The context.

Property discovery depends on current, structured data and useful search. My contribution focused on bringing third-party listing information into an application, organizing it consistently, and making it easier for customers to find relevant properties.

My contribution.

  1. Fetch and normalize third-party listing data for a Canadian real-estate application.
  2. Work with REALTOR.ca-related listing data and integration workflows.
  3. Build search and filtering behavior around structured property attributes.
  4. Support listing refreshes and live or near-real-time update workflows.
  5. Improve how property information is presented to users.

The result.

  • External data transformed into a searchable property experience.
  • A foundation for keeping listing discovery aligned with refreshed source data.
An API feed becomes a product only when its data is consistent, current, and understandable.
